description:
A table's dimensions in key order with their codes (id, name, parent).
Use search to find the codes for labels like 'Ontario' instead of guessing.

dimension.description: Key position: return every code of that dimension (default: first 10 per dimension), plus leaf_key, its lowest-level codes as a '+' OR.

search.description: Return only codes whose name contains this text (case-insensitive), across all dimensions, e.g. 'Ontario'. Separate several terms with ';'.

name: get_sdmx_structure
